newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's NSW has A$215 mln August surplus.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's NSW has A$215 mln August surplus.

text.p: The underlying New South Wales (NSW) budget sector financial result for August was a surplus of A$215 million compared with a A$49 million deficit for the same period last year, the NSW Treasurer Michael Egan said.

Egan said this year's improved result is mainly attributable to the earlier receipt of dividends from non-budget sector agencies such as Pacific Power and Sydney Water. The A$215 million surplus comprised of A$586 million on the current account and a deficit of A$371 million on the capital account.
